title: HTTP/3 frame
summary: HTTP/3 (over QUIC) frames use a variable-length integer (QUIC varint) for both type and length, followed by a payload. Frame types: DATA (0x00), HEADERS (0x01), CANCEL_PUSH (0x03), SETTINGS (0x04), PUSH_PROMISE (0x05), GOAWAY (0x07), MAX_PUSH_ID (0x0D). Unlike HTTP/2, frames are not tied to streams by a frame header field; the QUIC stream itself provides the stream context.

structure.meaning: Frame-specific data (HEADERS carries QPACK-encoded headers, DATA carries body, ...).

notes: QUIC varints use the top 2 bits of the first byte to indicate length: 00 = 1 byte (6-bit value), 01 = 2 bytes, 10 = 4 bytes, 11 = 8 bytes.
HTTP/3 removes HTTP/2's stream-id field from the frame header; QUIC streams provide the context.
QPACK (RFC 9204) replaces HPACK for header compression, with encoder/decoder streams.
SETTINGS are sent as frames on the control stream (stream 2 for client, 3 for server).
MAX_DATA / MAX_STREAM_DATA flow control is handled by QUIC, not HTTP/3.
